name: Ezz Steel
source: Ezz Steel Company (SAE) Consolidated Financial Statements for the year ended 31 December 2023, audited, consolidated statement of financial position, printed in EGP thousands and stored here in absolute EGP. Read from the exchange-library scan of the signed filing by optical character recognition; every row is confirmed by the sheet's own identities: Non-current plus Current Assets equals Total Assets, Non-current plus Current Liabilities equals Total Liabilities, and Total Assets equals Total Liabilities plus Total Equity, exactly on both years.
note: All figures in absolute EGP, converted from the statement's EGP thousands. FY2023 and FY2022 as printed. Current and Non-current Assets both tie to Total Assets, and Current and Non-current Liabilities both tie to Total Liabilities, so the split is the printed subtotal and not an apportionment. Total Equity is the printed Total Shareholders' Equity line.
